questions.text: If the user saves the same text twice, what happens?
options: Duplicate records are created (each Save is a new set of expenses)
The second Save is refused for entries already saved (please say how a duplicate is recognised in a comment)
questions.reason: REQ-278 open question and walkthrough gap 7. Two real expenses can be identical (two F 250 lunches on one day), so preventing duplicates needs a rule for what counts as the same entry.
questions.answer: Duplicate records are created (each Save is a new set of expenses)

questions.text: What exactly is saved when the user presses Save?
options: The API expands the typed text again at save time and saves that result (the server is the only source of truth)
The API saves the values shown in the review, sent back by the web app, after checking them
questions.reason: Technical choice. REQ-278 says 'exactly as shown in the review'. With re-expansion, a review made before midnight and saved after it shifts td/yd dates by one day; with saved review values, the API must re-check what the browser sends. Recommendation: re-expand, and refuse the save if any result differs from what was reviewed.
questions.answer: The API expands the typed text again at save time and saves that result (the server is the only source of truth)
